findings.issue: `isSeparable_of_aeval_eq` repeats almost line for line the proof at `PlaneCurve/Basic.lean:89-103`: `IsAlgebraic.isIntegral`, then `separable_iff_derivative_ne_zero (minpoly.irreducible hint)`, then `minpoly.dvd`, `derivative_mul`, `minpoly.aeval`, then `isSeparable_adjoin_simple_iff_isSeparable` and `equivOfEq`/`topEquiv`. Both are special cases of one field-level fact, and neither uses anything specific to `RatFunc k`.

summary: Theorem hypotheses are at the natural level. However, the new `isSeparable_of_aeval_eq` (with `finiteDimensional_of_aeval_eq`) re-proves the simple-root-generator argument already proved inline in `finiteDimensional_and_isSeparable_of_aeval_pderiv_one_ne_zero`, instead of factoring out the general lemma.
